product_wide_rationale: Keeps migration and correction demand-driven, retains the current replacement-readiness evidence floor, and removes unsupported Product-wide obligations without changing runtime behavior.
summary: Migration and correction are demand-driven and ad hoc. Replacement readiness remains an evidence claim. CD-0006 D1-D2 and CD-0053 D4 cutover framing are amended, while Domain, PM4, and data-integrity controls remain bounded and current.
title: Migration and replacement controls are demand-driven
